links.outcome: Whether MLLM step-by-step ECG reasoning is grounded in visual evidence
links.effect: Models retrieve clinical criteria but show near-zero success (6% Completion) in maintaining a complete reasoning chain, mainly failing to ground ECG findings in the visual signal.
links.quote: Although models possess the medical knowledge to retrieve clinical criteria for a diagnosis, they exhibit near-zero success rates (6% Completion) in maintaining a complete reasoning chain, primarily failing to ground the corresponding ECG findings to the actual visual evidence in the ECG signal.

unlisted_practices: Multi-turn step-by-step reasoning benchmark to test visual grounding of multimodal LLM ECG interpretation

screen.reason: The study introduces and runs an automated benchmark evaluating the clinical reasoning and visual grounding capabilities of multimodal large language models for ECG interpretation.
